title.zh: 读到 HALT 就停下来

brief.zh: 单步查看每条指令的效果，观察 HALT 后面的 ADD 会不会执行。
brief.en: Step through the program. See what happens to the ADD after HALT.

concept.zh: PC 数指令，程序在 HALT 停止。
concept.en: PC counts instructions. The program stops at HALT.

hints.zh: 对照左侧 PC 和右侧行号。注释与空行不会用掉一步。
hints.en: Compare PC with the source line numbers. Comments and blank lines take no steps.

starterCode:
# ACC = memory[0] + memory[1]
LOAD 0
ADD 1
STORE 2

HALT
ADD 0
